decision.rationale: Reproducible defect: changing cardId does not replace the draft fields or clear dirty state, violating BG-H01-INV-PROP-RESET. The revision layout effect updates current.current to the new identity but never assigns the new initialTitle and initialTheme to the title/theme signals. Its actionLog update triggers a render that exposes the new cardId alongside the previous card’s draft; isDirty then compares that stale draft against the new identity inputs.
